title: Xi Xing Ji: Asura Season 2 Episode 12 Indonesia, English Sub
description:
English

Season 2 of Asura picks up where Season 1 left off, plunging straight into an all-out war between Asura and the gods. Standing alone against the world, Asura unleashes his fury, shatters the laws of Heaven, and slaughters the gods above!

Indonesia

Asura S2, melanjutkan kisah perang antara kaum Asura dan para Dewa. Ia berjuang seorang diri melawan dunia, sang Raja memupuk amarahnya, menentang hukum langit, dan bertekad untuk membinasakan setiap Dewa yang menghalangi jalannya!
